value.name: asks about missing keys
value.description: Asha quietly asks why his keys are still in the jacket by the door, signaling an unspoken concern about the absent man.
evidence: "why are his keys still in the jacket by the door."

value.name: Claire hesitates before answering
value.description: Claire tightens her grip on the chair and pauses without answering, showing she is struggling to respond.
evidence: "Claire's fingers tightened on the chair and she drew a breath that did not quite become an answer"

value.name: Asha senses the night ahead
value.description: In Claire's silence, Asha feels the weight of the coming night settle on her before anything is said aloud.
evidence: "Asha felt the shape of the night ahead settle on her shoulders before either of them had named a single thing out loud."

value.name: Asha joins Claire at the table
value.description: Asha crosses into the kitchen and places her hand beside Claire's on the table in a quiet gesture of support.
evidence: "Asha crossed the rest of the way into the kitchen and set her hand flat on the table beside Claire's, not covering it, just there"

value.name: silence replaces questions
value.description: Asha chooses silence over pressing Claire for answers, letting the moment speak for itself.
evidence: "let the silence do what questions could not"

value.name: Claire remains unable to speak
value.description: Claire keeps her head down, presses her thumb into the chair, and breathes shakily without forming words.
evidence: "Claire did not look up; her thumb pressed a small white crescent into the wood at the chair's edge, and her breath went in once, paused, and came out without shape."

value.name: Asha ignores Rosa's call
value.description: Asha notices her phone buzzing with Rosa's call but deliberately lets it ring, taking Rosa's advice to listen instead of pushing Claire.
evidence: "Asha's phone buzzed against her hip a second time and she let it, though she registered the weight of it: Rosa, somewhere across the city, telling her not to push, to listen to the breath Claire took before she spoke."

value.name: Asha observes the household clues
value.description: Asha silently takes in the cereal box, rinsed bowls, and locked back door as signs of the tense situation in the house.
evidence: "The cereal box on the counter, the two rinsed bowls, the deadbolt thrown against a back door no one had come through"

value.name: Asha waits for Claire to speak
value.description: Asha holds back and waits for Claire to decide what the next words in the house will be.
evidence: "she waited for Claire to decide what the next sentence in this house was going to be."

value.name: Asha closes the distance without touching
value.description: Asha inches her hand closer to Claire's without making contact, offering warmth and support while preserving Claire's space.
evidence: "Asha let her hand drift a fraction closer to Claire's on the wood, not touching, only narrowing the gap until Claire could feel the warmth of it without having to acknowledge it."
